title: ItipNorm
description: ITIP base Archetype for Norm — the verification half of the DNA grammar. Inherits gsm/Norm through the top-level $ref and composes the ITIP-wide ItipAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Norm statement distributed in an ITIP framework MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Norm, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: ITIP (framework foundation).
